recent_posts.title: Comparing 6 headless CMS platforms for React and Next.js in 2026
recent_posts.summary: A comparison of six headless CMS platforms for React and Next.js projects in 2026: Prismic, Sanity, Contentful, Payload CMS, Strapi, and DatoCMS. Each platform is evaluated on TypeScript support, Next.js App Router compatibility, SDK quality, pricing, and React Server Component support. Prismic leads for visual page building, Sanity for customizable editing, Contentful for enterprise, Payload for full-stack Next.js integration, Strapi for self-hosted open-source, and DatoCMS for TypeScript-first GraphQL teams. The post also covers how React Server Components have changed CMS SDK requirements and provides a checklist for evaluating any CMS SDK.

recent_posts.title: Building a GEO Benchmark Tool by Polling LLMs at Scale
recent_posts.summary: Prismic built an internal tool to measure brand visibility across AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini by polling LLMs at scale. The approach involves running identical prompts multiple times across different models using Vercel's AI SDK to get statistical patterns of brand mentions. Key learnings include avoiding structured output in favor of natural prompts for accuracy, handling provider-specific quirks, and understanding cost tradeoffs. The tool evolved from a marketing experiment into a sales enablement resource, generating prospect-specific GEO benchmarks before calls at roughly $0.50-1.00 per 120-prompt run.

recent_posts.title: Folloze alternatives for account based marketing campaigns
recent_posts.summary: Folloze is a buyer experience platform for creating personalized content hubs and microsites in ABM campaigns. This comparison evaluates 10 alternatives organized by category: content experience platforms (Userled, PathFactory), personalized landing page builders (Prismic), website personalization tools (Mutiny), and full ABM orchestration platforms (Demandbase, 6sense, Terminus). Teams typically seek alternatives due to implementation complexity, pricing, or needing specialized capabilities. The guide recommends choosing based on primary use case—Userled for multi-asset content hubs, Prismic for scaling personalized landing pages, Mutiny for website personalization, or Demandbase/6sense for comprehensive ABM orchestration. Success depends more on strategy, data quality, and team alignment than tool selection.

recent_posts.title: LandingRabbit alternatives for personalized ABM landing pages
recent_posts.summary: LandingRabbit alternatives for ABM landing pages range from specialized tools to general page builders. Prismic generates hundreds of page variations from a single template with marketing-owned workflows. Mutiny provides AI-powered personalization across entire websites. UserLed combines account identification with personalized pages for product-led companies. Unbounce and Instapage offer drag-and-drop builders with A/B testing. HubSpot CMS Hub integrates with CRM data for smart content. Leadpages targets small businesses with affordable templates. Landingi focuses on GDPR compliance and European markets. The right choice depends on scale needs, existing tech stack, budget, and whether you need standalone campaign pages or full website personalization.
